readings.statement: [TRUE_IS_PROHIBITED] For the selected paragraph-10 gift-promotion control, within the stated actor-and-offer scope, true means the assessed benefit is a gift, is not a fees-or-charges discount, and either has the specified promotional connection or is offered in a manner linking it to a particular investment-product type. Actual investor distraction need not be proved. This is a proposed reading of the selected control only.
readings.subject: Paragraph-10 gift control: product-type linkage as a sufficient connection

assumptions: The assessment unit is one benefit offered to one client; separate benefits in a package require separate assessment.
Both alternatives use the circular’s defined distributor population as a common bounded scope.
The final sentence illustrates the first sentence’s promotion requirement and retains that requirement.
The discount exception continues to apply to gifts mentioned in the final sentence.
Unknown classification or connection facts remain unknown.

citations.quote: distributors should not offer any gifts (other than a discount of fees or charges) in promoting a specific investment product or a particular type of investment product to a client.
The purpose of the requirement is to avoid the use of gifts to distract investors from the features and risks of a particular product.
then such gifts will be bound by this requirement
3 The answer to question 1 of the frequently asked questions on the Code of Conduct issued by the SFC on 30 September 2010.

readings.distinction: A promotional connection remains necessary in every case; product-type linkage supports that finding but is not an independent trigger. If linkage is established and promotion is affirmatively absent, this alternative does not flag the offer while the first does. This reading is less secure against the final sentence’s express if/then wording; the referenced but absent FAQ is the strongest unresolved dependency.

readings.statement: [TRUE_IS_PROHIBITED] For the selected paragraph-10 gift-promotion control, within the stated actor-and-offer scope, true means the assessed benefit is a gift, is not a fees-or-charges discount, and is offered in promoting a specific investment product or particular product type. Linkage to a fund type or fund house informs the promotion assessment but does not replace it. Actual investor distraction need not be proved. This is a proposed reading of the selected control only.
